behavior.openalex_names: Publication raw_author_name only; entity display name retained separately, never substituted for missing raw name.
behavior.openalex_identifiers: Entity ID/display name/raw ORCID kept as observations; generic publisher orcid remains null.
behavior.verified_bridge: Requires both Crossref context and Crossref authorship plus existing registry external Scopus-ID bridge; name variants do not invalidate that independent proof.
behavior.raw_assignment: Count+position+raw name may corroborate; names and entity ORCID never independently verify.
behavior.persisted_provenance: Existing JSON evidence carries source_observation and complete source_authorship_observations, source/work/DOI/time, target Scopus ID/order and publisher/entity fields separately; withholding retains original evidence.
behavior.fingerprints: Include policy version; same-policy replay deterministic; changed policy yields distinct payload identity.
behavior.historical_rows: Not modified. No automatic downgrade/revocation/reimport. Old unsafe survey JSONL can intentionally fail source recomputation checks.
behavior.identity_decisions: None; external authorship verification remains distinct from canonical lecturer approval.
behavior.registry_scope: External Scopus identifiers only; not new DOI-work validation or T1–T6 implementation.

baseline.interpretation: Includes missing new provenance fields and direct reproduction of unsafe VERIFIED from entity ORCID/missing raw name.
